verdict.rationale: The Texas Secretary of State is a government business-registry and filing authority run through its hosted SOSPortal. Filings only take legal effect with the state itself, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of service rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable distribution; the only offline material is the downloadable forms directory, which is a document library, not the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
